content: वी I. €2 <ab>P.</ab> (वेति, rarely used in classical literature) .²1 To go, move. .²2 To approach. .²3 To pervade. .²4 To bring, convey. .²5 To throw, cast. .²6 To eat, consume. .²7 to obtain. .²8 To conceive, bring forth. .²9 To be born or produced. .²10 To shine, be beautiful. .²11 To desire, wish. .²12 To shine. --II. (वि + इ) €2 <ab>P.</ab> .²1 To go away, depart; तस्यामहं त्वयि च संप्रति वीतचिन्तः <ls>Ś. 4. 13</ls>; so वीतभय, वीतक्रोध, <ab>etc.</ab> .²2 To undergo a change; सदृशं त्रिषु लिङ्गेषु यन्न व्येति तदव्ययम् <ls>Sk.</ls> .²3 To spend. .²4 To be diffused, to spread. .²5 To vanish, disappear. .²6 To cross over, traverse.
वीः .²1 Act of going, motion. .²2 A female bird.
